notes: DBI module names identify linker inputs, including archives and LTCG products; they need not identify original source units.
Direct module procedure records and unique section contributions support object attribution, not original source ownership through LTCG.
Assert file references are qualified secondary evidence: macro and inline expansion can cite another file.
Generated maps are evidence inventories. No entry is a compiled-source match or a byte-gate admission.
Object lanes allocate disjoint public start sets; they do not infer C/C++ source filenames, function sizes, or independence from cross-unit LTCG.
